objective: Replace Electron's problematic Node built-in WebSocket transport for the VTube Studio adapter with the pinned ws RFC-6455 client so CurrentModelResponse and hotkey responses are received reliably on the real loopback API.
non_goals: Do not expose VTube Studio outside 127.0.0.1 or return the authentication token to the renderer.
Do not load or redistribute a Live2D model; the owner remains responsible for model rights and selection.
Do not accept arbitrary WebSocket URLs, headers, subprotocols or API payloads.
Do not remove the narrow empty-frame compatibility branch or fail-open on malformed frames.
contracts: Only the Electron main process creates a ws client for the fixed VTube Studio loopback endpoint.
Text frames are delivered to the existing bounded parser as strings; binary frames remain protocol errors.
Authentication, request correlation, timeout, disconnect, token redaction and the VRM fallback contracts remain unchanged.
The dependency is pinned with registry integrity and MIT provenance in the repository lock/notice/SBOM inputs.
allowed_dependencies: ws 8.21.1 for the Node RFC-6455 client
acceptance_criteria: A real loopback smoke with the stored token receives CurrentModelResponse.modelLoaded=true for the currently selected Hiyori model.
The focused fake WebSocket suite remains green, including empty-frame compatibility and malformed-frame fail-closed tests.
Desktop typecheck/build passes with no native optional WebSocket addon required.
The dependency provenance, license and integrity are recorded; no token or user model path appears in logs.
